name: Mirecrown Linnorm - Adult
description: Adult Mirecrown is a chaotic, instinct-driven worldborn linnorm clever, wingless, non-humanoid linnorm with mud-caked scales, reed-crowned sensory spines, and a broad paddle tail. It seeks to restore blocked waterways and defend its nesting grounds. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Ambush Bite
attacks.description: The linnorm strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The linnorm can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Mud Camouflage
abilities.description: Before the linnorm first attacks or after it becomes Hidden in a wetland, a creature must succeed on an Instinct Roll to locate it.

abilities.name: Choking Spray
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 18. On a failure, take 3d8+6 physical damage and the target marks 1 Stress from bile and rotting peat. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Death Roll
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Make an attack against one creature within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d12+5 physical damage and make the target Restrained in its jaws until the target escapes with a successful Strength Roll.

abilities.name: Submerge
abilities.description: After taking damage in deep water or mud, mark a Stress to move to another point within Close range and become Hidden until it attacks or an enemy locates it with a successful Instinct Roll.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the linnorm marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
